educationalGoal: This course aims at further development of basic grammar through communication tas ks. Students will focus on developing skills of communication in modern Japanese r eading, writing, speaking, and listening.
advice: This course is a continuation of Japanese Communication 2. It aims to help students further develop the four ba sic skills of communication. Students will build on their previous knowledge and continue to increase their know ledge of intermediate-high level grammar (also review grammar previously learned and how it applies to living in Japan), vocabulary, and idioms, as well as socio-cultural aspects of Japanese that are essential for accurate c ommunication. Students will also increase their awareness of different style and speech levels (e.g., written an d spoken style, formal and informal speech, and keigo). This course has a Moodle course site. All important information about course related matters will be posted on t his site. It is students' responsibility to check the site regularly.
books: QUARTET I: Intermediate Japanese Across the Four Language Skills [The Japan times publishing] QUARTET I Workbook
requiredKnowledge: Japanese 200 level with a grade of C or higher.

activityGoals.body: Understand and improve intermediate-high level grammar.
Conduct complicated conversations in daily situations in both formal and informal settings.
Understand important information from essays, stories, articles, and other authentic materials.
Understand social and cultural manners to have appropriate communication.
Write essays and reports in the appropriate form and style.
